verdict.rationale: OpenAI documents a dedicated Structured Outputs feature that 'ensures the model will always generate responses that adhere to your supplied JSON Schema'. The changelog confirms structured outputs and function calling on the flagship model, which directly delivers schema-constrained responses that code can consume without fragile parsing. Missing for 10: evidence of natively typed SDK helpers (e.g., parsing directly into typed language objects), and independent or hands-on corroboration of schema adherence in practice.
